name: Peaches
description: Grown under the same weather-magic as starflower wine; they ripen on a schedule no ordinary orchard can match. Halarahh's binding-towers keep the technique in-house, so this is the only place in Faerûn the trees fruit at all.

name: Skyship elemental core
description: A bound air or fire elemental, the heart of every Halruaan skyship. Made only in Halarahh's binding-towers.

name: Cloudweave silk
description: Sail-cloth spun with a minor levitation charm woven into the thread itself.

name: Starflower wine
description: A pale, glowing vintage from vineyards that only fruit under Halruaa's controlled weather-magic.

name: Levitation draught
description: A Halruaan alchemical secret; seized imitations always turn out inert.

name: Grave dust
description: Necromantic reagent rendered from Thayan burial pits under Red Wizard supervision.

name: Spellscar tattoo ink
description: Pigment that binds a spell to living skin; replication attempts elsewhere produce scarring instead.

name: Fire-wine
description: Spiced, fortified wine brewed hot; the recipe doesn't survive transit without Red Wizard preservation charms.

name: Clockwork mechanism
description: Precision gearwork for golems, ship instruments and automata; Lantan guilds guard the tooling itself.

name: Far-seer lens
description: Ground glass enchanted for scrying and signal-lamps; the glass formula is Lantan's alone.

name: Zurkhwood
description: Petrified fungus-wood used in drow architecture; forms only in the deep fungal groves near Menzoberranzan.

name: Deep rothe cheese
description: Made from Underdark rothe milk by Blingdenstone's svirfneblin; the herds do not survive on the surface.

name: Duergar grey ale
description: Gracklstugh's forge-ale, brewed with mineral water found only in that cavern.

name: Remorhaz chitin plate
description: Armor plate from hunted remorhaz; the creatures exist nowhere outside the Dale's ice sheets.

name: Yeti pelt
description: Thick white pelt taken from Icewind Dale's high-country yetis; the fur doesn't hold its loft anywhere warmer.

name: Reghed frost mead
description: A tundra-herb mead brewed by the Reghed barbarians.

name: Zombie lotus pollen
description: Paralytic alchemical reagent; loses potency within hours of leaving Chult's humidity.

name: Batiri dart venom
description: Batiri-brewed paralytic dart poison; the recipe doesn't survive the trip out of Chult's jungle intact.

name: Firepepper sauce
description: Fermented jungle pepper sauce, bottled at Port Nyanzaru and Tashluta alike.

name: Fulgurite moon-glass
description: Glass fused from sand by desert lightning strikes, gathered by Bedine nomads after storms.

name: Bedine camel-cord
description: Rope woven from desert camel hair; ordinary hemp has no equivalent give in sand.

name: Woad
description: Sacred blue war-dye; loses its color if dried anywhere but the Moonshaes.

name: Earthmother's amber
description: Amber sacred to the Earthmother faith, gathered only from the Moonshae shore-shrines.

name: Kelp ale
description: Brewed with shore-kelp by the Ffolk; the brew turns flat within a season if kept off the islands.

name: Mythal dust
description: Residual magic swept from within Myth Drannor's mythal; stocks are effectively fixed.

name: Singing crystal
description: Resonant crystal grown in Evereska's hidden vale, used as a bardic and arcane focus.

name: Deep runestone
description: Pre-inscribed enchanting stone from Citadel Adbar's forge-priests; the method is a clan secret.

name: Masterwork warhammer
description: Clan-forged masterwork; the smithing line traces to Mithral Hall alone.

name: Flying carpet
description: Enchanted-weave carpet; the binding technique is a closely held Calimport guild secret.

name: Genasi glass censer
description: Incense burner shaped with genie-fire glassblowing, a technique found only in Calimshan's genasi-run foundries.

name: Cloudsilk
description: Sail-cloth for cloud ships; Nimbral's isolationism keeps the technique off the mainland.

name: Illusionist's veil
description: Cloth treated with a permanent minor-illusion weave, a Nimbral specialty.

name: War-charger
description: A named bloodline bred only in Chessenta's plains studs.

name: Bronze
description: An alloy from Chessentan foundries with a closely guarded tin ratio.

name: Embalming resin
description: Preservation resin used in Mulhorandi funerary rites; the source tree grows only along the River of Swords.

name: River lotus oil
description: Perfume oil from the sacred lotus, harvested under priesthood control.

name: Ziggurat clay
description: Fired clay for ritual pottery, drawn from Unther's old riverbed deposits.

name: Sea-oak planking
description: Dense, rot-resistant timber found only in Turmish's old-growth coastal forest.

name: Silver ore
description: Unsmelted; Mirabar exports the raw ore under strict guild licence rather than finished ingots.

name: Oak timber
description: Old-growth hardwood from two unrelated stands: common Vilhon Reach lumber out of Chondath, and higher-priced Cormanthor-edge oak cut under elven-treaty limits out of the Dalelands.

name: Glass sand
description: Fine silica sand from the Lake of Steam shore; Innarlith's glassworks buy most of it before it leaves the docks.

name: Natron
description: Mineral salt drawn from dry riverbed flats, used in preservation and tanning.

name: Mineral salt
description: Crude mineral salt from the hot-spring flats, coarser and cheaper than refined common salt.

name: Dates
description: Oasis staple, a caravan ration as much as a foodstuff.

name: Sea salt
description: Pan-evaporated along the coast; the Yuir Isles' shallows make the yield unusually pure. Sword Coast and Moonshae pan-evaporators produce a coarser grade at lower cost; Aglarond's Yuir Isles yield stays the premium pick.

name: Surplus grain
description: Waterdeep's breadbasket; the temple-farmed surplus at Goldenfields undercuts common grain on price alone.

name: Garnet
description: Rough-cut from Thayan mine workings, sold uncut to keep the export tariff low.

name: Jade
description: Riverbed jade from the deep jungle interior; Port Nyanzaru brokers see it before anyone else does.

name: Raw amber
description: Uncut coastal amber, cheaper than the polished amber already in trade; Sembian jewelers keep the best pieces home.

name: Witch-herbs
description: Rashemi hathran herb-lore, gathered in Rashemen and sold onward through Thesk's caravan markets.

name: Healing root
description: A woodland root used in salves; it doesn't take well to transplanting outside Cormanthor's soil.

name: Starflower
description: Grown in Silverymoon's terraced gardens for minor enchantments and healing draughts.

name: Walrus ivory
description: Raw ivory, unworked; the finished scrimshaw already in the catalog is carved from stock like this. Trackless Sea whaling and sealing crews bring in a smaller supplementary haul.

name: Cattle horn
description: Horn and bone for tool handles and glue, a byproduct of the Vast's grazing economy. Western Heartlands ranches contribute a comparable byproduct stream.

name: Crocodile hide
description: Tannable jungle hide, priced well under the exotic dinosaur hide it's often sold alongside. Tashalar's spice-coast wetlands support a smaller parallel hunt.

name: Raw flax
description: Amn's river-bottom flax fields feed the region's own linen trade before any of it ships raw. Cormyr's river-bottom farms grow a comparable crop, though Amn's fields still feed most of the export trade.

name: Raw wool
description: The Vast's open grasslands support herding on a scale most of the Sword Coast can't match. Western Heartlands flocks add meaningfully to supply during good grazing years.

name: Raw furs
description: Untreated pelts off the Rashemen border, bundled and sold onward through Thesk's caravan markets. Icewind Dale trappers supply a heavier, colder-climate pelt alongside Thesk's Rashemen-border stock.

name: Citrus
description: Vilhon Reach citrus groves supply the same coast that builds the ships.

name: Breadfruit
description: A jungle staple, cheap and filling, distinct from the luxury chultan fruit already in trade.

name: Plantains
description: The spice coast's other export; less glamorous than pepper, twice the tonnage.

name: Figs
description: Sold alongside dates as a matched caravan ration pair.

name: Apples
description: Orchards tended at Cormanthor's edge, the same treaty land that yields the healing root.

name: Pears
description: Grassland orchards that grew up alongside the region's grazing economy.

name: Wild berries
description: Foraged, not farmed; the Ffolk consider cultivating them bad luck.

name: Pineapple
description: A gnomish plantation crop, grown in glasshouses as much as fields.

name: Dried peaches
description: Sun-dried before the crate ever leaves Halarahh's orchards; the fresh fruit doesn't survive a skyship's own cargo hold.

name: Candied citrus peel
description: Preserved in its own sugared syrup for the Vilhon Passage crossing.

name: Dried breadfruit
description: Smoked and dried at Port Nyanzaru before export; the fresh crop barely survives the jungle heat, let alone a sea lane.

name: Dried plantains
description: Sliced and sun-dried on the Tashalar docks before the crate ever goes to sea.

name: Dried figs
description: Desert sun-drying was the original point of the fig; the fresh version is really the local-market exception.

name: Dried apples
description: Ring-sliced and air-dried in the Dalelands before the caravan season starts.

name: Dried pears
description: Halved and dried on racks across the Vast's grassland orchards.

name: Dried berries
description: Foraged berries spoil fastest of anything on this list; drying is what makes them a trade good at all rather than a local-market curiosity.

name: Candied pineapple
description: Gnomish confectioners candy the surplus crop that doesn't sell fresh.

name: Stabilized lotus extract
description: Alchemically fixed within hours of harvest. The raw pollen loses potency before it clears Chult's border; this is the only form most buyers outside the jungle ever see.
